editorial.blurb: A masterclass in elevated Italian comfort food from restaurateur Richie Labriola, where world-class handmade pasta and perfectly crafted pizza meet impeccable service and vibrant Chicago energy.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive ready to order the Wagyu meatballs in wedding soup and don't skip the bread service—ask your server for cocktail recommendations like the Amare or Paloma, which pair beautifully with the housemade pastas.

topDishes.note: Something special—reviewers rave about their quality
